description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gedarawela, Imbulpe D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620753 (23/1200154)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title registration, cadastral mapping, and determination of land ownership/possession interests across multiple districts. The content focuses entirely on land administration and property rights without any government personnel changes, structural modifications, or other specialized categories. This fits the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and related matters.
